text:
Maya: Quick support ticket follow-up  customers confused by the embeddings example on the ratecard page (shows \"per-request\"). I opened PR to fix wording + add a compact 1k-token worked example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8622
Ethan: Good catch. I'll update the SDK snippets to prefer the usage helpers and include a tiny tokenizer helper example. Plan: Node + Python + short raw-headers appendix. ETA ~45m.
Pri: I'll check the pricing table CSV and the downloadable JSON; those need the same per-token wording and an example column for cost per 1k tokens. Will open a follow-up PR if needed.
Maya: Also: grafana link at bottom 404s for community users. We should swap to the public metering dashboard and update the panel id. Can someone take link fix?
Ethan: I can handle the grafana swap as part of snippet PR. Will replace internal path with https://grafana.redwood.com/d/public/metering and set panelId to 42 (tokens_ingested).
Pri: One ask from support: include a tiny migration note mapping old header names to new ones (X-Rate-Limit -> X-Burst-Remaining, X-Req-Count -> X-Usage-Tokens) and a short blurb about burst_credit semantics. Support wants copy they can paste into tickets.
Ethan: I'll add a new subsection titled \"Migration notes (v2 -> v3 headers)\" with a one-paragraph mapping and this code snip for token estimation: 
```python
# estimate tokens for embedding (approx)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
approx = client.tokenizer.estimate('some long text...')
print(f\"~{approx} tokens\")
```
Maya: Nice. Keep the docs-first approach: SDK example first, raw headers below for advanced integrators. Also add a short formula people can copy: tokens = ceil(char_count / 4).
Pri: I'll sync the pricing CSV: changed the column \"unit\" to \"tokens\" and added an example row: \"embeddings, per 1000 tokens, $0.05\". Pushed draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8624
InfraBot: ci: lint OK for PR 8622, 8624; link-check queued. Examples-smoke queued for node+python.
Ethan: Pushed snippet updates to 8622; included both client.usage.fetch_range() examples and a raw-header appendix that shows `X-Usage-Tokens` and `X-Burst-Remaining`. Also left a comment about eventual minor rounding differences between aggregated usage and per-request header totals.
Maya: Can we add one small worked calculation for a 1k-token embedding so customers can copy/paste? Something like:
```text
1k-token embedding cost = (1000 / 1000) * $0.05 = $0.05
```
Pri: Added that in PR 8624 top-of-file example. Also included a tiny FAQ row: \"Why might my client headers total differ from client.usage.fetch_range?\" with answer about aggregation windows and rounding.
DocsBot: info: link-check flagged 3 external 404s across other pages; re-running after PR merges recommended.
Ethan: Rebased after a small merge conflict and pushed again. PR 8622 updated.
InfraBot: examples-smoke completed: node+python OK. Link-check re-run queued.
Maya: Once link-check is green, let's merge in order: 8622 (snippets+migration) -> 8624 (pricing CSV) to minimize churn. Pri, please rebase 8624 onto 8622 if needed.
Pri: Will rebase and run the pricing validator. Noted the validator cares about column order; fixed in 8624.
DocsBot: completed: link-check passed for 8622 and 8624. changelog: docs updated (embeddings billed per-token; new header names; public metering dashboard link).
Maya: Great job team. I'll put a short \"what changed\" banner at the top of the quotas + ratecard pages for support to copy. If anything blocks merge, ping here.
Ethan: One tiny follow-up: open a micro-PR to add the FAQ item about aggregation timing vs headers (already drafted).
Pri: Thanks all. Merging now.
DocsBot: merged PRs: 8622, 8624. Notifying #support and updating release notes.
